messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: `P1 - edge.tls.handshake_spike` (service: edge-gateway). Initial symptoms: spike in TLS handshake failures from multiple regions. Pager: pagerduty

pagerduty: Alert details -> severity: P1, triggered by 5xx-rate > 10% over 1m for api.redwood.prod, regions affected: eu-west-1, eu-central-1. Escalation policy: on-call -> Sanjay -> Maya -> L3. Auto-escalated in 2m.

Sanjay: acked. I'm taking initial triage. @Maya are you awake?

Maya: on it. seeing increased 525/526-ish errors at edge, looks like TLS handshake failures, not backend 5xx. Quick check: `curl -v https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.prod/health` gives "SSL routines:tls_process_server_certificate:certificate verify failed" on a few boxes.

Sanjay: hmm. Did we push cert rotation last night? I remember a cert roll for intermediate chain update at 02:15 UTC.

Maya: yes, cert-rotation job ran 02:14-02:17 UTC. My initial hypothesis: incomplete cert chain on some ALB nodes or missing intermediate causing some clients to fail. But why only eu regions? maybe partial rollout or different LB image.

Leo: chiming in. I'm running `aws elbv2 describe-listeners --load-balancer-arn <arn-eu-west>` and `aws elbv2 describe-listener-certificates` now. If nodes have mixed certs that explains inconsistent handshake success.

Maya: copying logs from edge-proxy (abbreviated):
```
[03:05:12] tls: handshake failure: unknown certificate verify error
[03:05:13] client_ip=1.2.3.4 sni=api.redwood.prod
[03:05:13] backend: upstream connect ok
```

Sanjay: also seeing raised client-side TLS version negotiation errors in our telemetry. Not a cipher mismatch, looks cert-chain related.

Leo: ok `describe-listener-certificates` shows mixed certs: some listeners have `redwood-prod-2026-intermediate-v2.pem`, others still using `redwood-prod-2024-chain.pem`. certificate ARN rotation seems half-applied across target groups. That matches partial rollout.

Maya: can we temporarily revert the rotation for eu-west and eu-central to the previous full-chain cert? That will restore uniform behavior. Rollback path: redeploy old cert to affected ALBs via cert manager job or `aws elbv2 add-listener-certificates`/`remove-listener-certificates`.

Sanjay: agreed. Risk of rollback minimal for TLS. Do it cautiously: one region at a time and watch metrics. Also open a temporary mitigation: disable clients' strict OCSP stapling check? (not ideal). Prefer rollback.

Elena: customer-facing note: CS is seeing increase in support tickets for API errors in EU. ETA for rollback? we need a short blurb for customers.

Maya: starting rollback for eu-west-1 now. Command I'm running: `aws elbv2 add-listener-certificates --listener-arn <arn> --certificates CertificateArn=<old-cert-arn>` then remove the bad cert. Doing it node-by-node with 30s pause. Posting progress.

incident-bot: Action started by Maya: certificate rollback job queued (job-id: rb-4471). Notifying on-call.

Maya: eu-west-1 rollback complete on primary ALB. Observability: handshake-failure rate dropped from 18% -> 3% over 2m. Latency stable. Continuing eu-central-1.

Sanjay: good. flip eu-central next. @Leo please watch target health and health checks during swap.

Leo: watching. running `aws elbv2 describe-target-health` for eu-central target group: all healthy as we swap certs. no backend 5xx surge.

Maya: eu-central rollback done. handshake failures down to baseline ~0.5%. PagerDuty auto notes: incident state updated to "mitigated" but keep P1 until we confirm full remediation and postmortem.

Sanjay: thanks all. initial customer impact estimate: ~5-12% of EU API requests failed for ~12 minutes between 03:05-03:17 UTC, spike concentrated on clients with stricter cert chain checks (older clients). CS: Elena can you prep a short message: what happened, mitigation taken, and guidance (clients should trust full chain, regen clients if pinned).

Elena: drafting now. proposed blurb: "We experienced a TLS certificate rotation that was partially applied in EU regions, causing intermittent TLS handshake failures for a subset of clients. We rolled back to the previous full-chain cert; service restored. We are investigating root cause and will follow up with a postmortem and long-term fix." Send if okay.

Sanjay: ok to send. Also create incident ticket: link https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-8421 (placeholder). Assign to Maya + infra.

Maya: filing root-cause checklist: 1) why rotation was partial (deploy job parallelism bug?), 2) add post-deploy validation for cert chain completeness, 3) improve runbook steps for rollback and monitoring thresholds.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: incident acknowledged by Sanjay, mitigated, awaiting postmortem. Incident closed by policy will require RCA.

Leo: handing off followups to Maya for RCA. I'm back to sleep, taking overnight watch pass to ensure no regressions.

Sanjay: thanks. final status: service restored, customer impact contained, P1 -> monitoring, postmortem to follow. Closing thread in 1h unless new alerts. :white_check_mark:
